title: BHAG
hook: Most goals I see are just last year's number plus ten percent. That won't get anyone out of bed.
statement: Set one huge, bold goal for the next 10 to 30 years that gets your whole team fired up.
explainer: A goal that big changes how you make every smaller call. It also pulls in people who'd never sign up for steady, safe work.
sop: Write a goal for the next 10 to 30 years that scares you a little.
Write one sentence on why it matters.
Break it into 3-year and yearly milestones.
Say it to your team often, until they can repeat it.
Use it as a filter for every big decision.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Audacity 9, Clarity 6, Belief 7. 9 × 6 × 7 = 378 out of 1,000. Higher means the goal steers decisions on its own. Lower means it's a big number nobody believes or knows how to reach.
question: Write down the 10-year goal so big that chasing it would change how you run things.
closing_statement: A goal too safe won't organize anything.
caption:
Principle Nº 274: BHAG

Most goals I see are just last year's number plus ten percent. That won't get anyone out of bed.

Set one huge, bold goal for the next 10 to 30 years that gets your whole team fired up.

Your turn: Write down the 10-year goal so big that chasing it would change how you run things.
